summary: Lost Ruins of Arnak blends deck-building with worker placement as you explore an island, gain resources, and fight guardians to unlock new areas and actions. It rewards building an efficient engine across cards, workers, and resources while managing a limited number of actions per round.
praised: excellent fusion of deck-building and worker placement
gorgeous art and thematic exploration feel
criticised: can feel a bit fiddly with many resource types

interaction.kind: worker placement contention over shared spaces

scoring.why: points come from research track progress, artifacts, guardians defeated, and end-game card bonuses
